description: Get the receipt for one of your workspace's priced calls, by its usage event id (the id list_usage_events returns and report_outcome takes): what was priced, by which function and agent, when, the amount, how it was paid, and the outcome if one was reported. Receipts are made only when you ask, never sent for every call. For CSV or a printable page, call GET /api/receipts/{id} with format=csv or format=html. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute or billing read scope.

usage_event_id.description: The priced call's usage event id, as list_usage_events returns it.

name: get_receipt
